verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for an online filing portal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes a chat, assistant or natural-language command interface: the Guichet unique is documented only as a web form and dashboard workflow. The Start INPI tutorial and video app is guidance content, not a natural-language way to operate the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
